descriptions.inProgress: If I handed #b#t4161033##k to #p2111000#, then the truth about #m261000000#, as well as all things #p2111002# strived for would be hidden forever. If that really is what I want for this to happen,  then I have no choice but to hand in #t1102135# and the note to #p2111000#.
descriptions.completed: I gave #p2111000# #t4161033#, and received a brand new Zenumist Cape. This has made me forfeit my right to contemn the Zenumists. This has now made me an integral part of the Zenumist.
